notes: The anywhere pie, rebuilt to Sensu's form: much larger and airier, with wide wedges and room to breathe. Brightness and Volume are no longer slices — they are arcs on the rim's two ends; grab one and sweep to set it. The centre shows the clock when idle and names what you're touching otherwise. The handle is now a slim 6dp pill. At Home, the fan's medallions are icon-only and spread wider, with the readout pill as the single label.
